title: Eliza Aligned Plugin
tagline: The Aligned layer plugin enables interaction with aligned layer through Eliza. It provides functionality for uploading proof, retrieving proof, and checking upload status on the aligned layer network.
description:
The aligned layer plugin enables interaction with aligned layer through Eliza. It provides functionality for uploading data, retrieving data, and checking upload status on the aligned network.
It is Features
- Upload data to aligned network
- Retrieve proof using job id
- Check upload status
- Automatic identifier management
- Automatic balance monitoring and top-up
- Support for text, JSON, and binary data
